This article explores how data centers are adopting sustainability practices beyond traditional Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). It highlights the use of **green leases**, **metrics like PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness), WUE (Water Usage Effectiveness), and CUE (Carbon Usage Effectiveness)**, and **innovative cooling technologies** such as immersion cooling to enhance efficiency. Additionally, it discusses advancements in **water conservation**, including reusable water systems, and **waste reduction** through recycling and repurposing materials. The role of **AI, modular design, and alternative materials** in driving sustainability is also emphasized.
